org.portico.impl.hla1516e.handlers

Class SupplementalInfo

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.impl.hla1516e.handlers.SupplementalInfo
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    hla.rti1516e.FederateAmbassador.SupplementalReceiveInfo, hla.rti1516e.FederateAmbassador.SupplementalReflectInfo, hla.rti1516e.FederateAmbassador.SupplementalRemoveInfo

    public class SupplementalInfo
extends Object
implements hla.rti1516e.FederateAmbassador.SupplementalReceiveInfo, hla.rti1516e.FederateAmbassador.SupplementalReflectInfo, hla.rti1516e.FederateAmbassador.SupplementalRemoveInfo
    Due to the introduction of the 433rd refelctAttributes(), receiveInteraction() and removeObject() overload, the grand high council of the API hath bequeathed us a new type to contain information we sometimes care about and mostly don't. Instances of this class shall now be passed to all overloads of the callbacks in question. Naturally this has been implemented as three separate interfaces (it is the HLA after all), all containing the same information only under a different name. My people, I give to you the SupplementalInfo class!

    Hold your applause. You're really too much. I know, I know. Thank me later.
